title: Gideon and the Inventory
author: Noor Dravenmoor
blurb: Freya Winterbourne, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
